writeup: JOOLA's Perseus MOD TA-15 Pro Player Edition pickleball paddle in the 16mm core is $79.99 on Woot, listed as part of an open-box warehouse clean-out. A new one runs $215 on SidelineSwap and $280 at The Fort, so it's about 62% less than the cheapest store. Heads up for competitive players: this paddle is no longer approved for USAP tournament play.
